title: •Brief Loss Of Control
caption: •Brief Loss Of Control (V)
game_text:
USED: Once per game, during opponent’s activate phase, target a location. Opponent is prevented from controlling that location (and loses senate majority if target is Galactic Senate) for remainder of turn.
LOST: Cancel Control.
lore: Eliciting fear from the opponent gives the dark side a powerful advantage.
